groups.sub: The Kuva Wytch (side Ryoku, kill Vena)
groups.activity: Skirmish into Assassinate; shoot every Orowyrm-sequence target
groups.meta: 14.29% each part, guaranteed one blueprint per clear
groups.mode: solo from Pontis Tower for your own Railjack
conditions: Squads always get a loaner Railjack (Vena's Marrowbone); your own ship only offers as an option from Pontis Tower, and only when matchmaking is set to Solo before you enter.
The Kuva Wytch pays Emerald Talent; Scoria's Angel (for the Wrath Blade) pays Crimson Talent separately; a part purchase spends only the matching Talent type.
A launch-week bug repeated the same drop run after run; if you see the same part three times in a row, fully close and reopen the client before assuming it's just variance.
bonuses: Each clear also guarantees one of four arcanes (Arcane Sculptor, Melee Assimilation, Primary Compression, Secondary Cryogenic).
12-16 Emerald Talent per clear (18-22 Steel Path), plus up to 4 more (12 Steel Path) for shooting every Orowyrm-sequence target; it's personal loot, so don't AFK through it.
The flying-segment bonus also drops Tellurium and Mk III Railjack parts.

disclosures.title: run Steel Path once you can
disclosures.body: Steel Path pays roughly 50% more Talent per clear, and both nodes run about 7 minutes solo.

groups.activity: Skirmish into Assassinate; shoot every Ramsled target
groups.meta: 14.29%, the only source of the Wrath Blade Pride needs
conditions: Forgetting this node is the most common mistake: Pride's recipe needs a Wrath Blade, and The Kuva Wytch never drops one.
The Ramsled targets sit right in front of you and are much easier to track than the Orowyrm's.
bonuses: Pays Crimson Talent and rolls Wrath's own frame/weapon parts on the same table, so this run also progresses Wrath if you want it.

groups.activity: buy whatever the drops didn't give
conditions: Duplicate blueprints can't be converted to Talent; buy the specific missing part instead of rolling for it again.
